description.value:
You gain one of the following features of your choice.

  • Stalker's Rake. You can Hide as a Bonus Action. If you hit a creature with your natural weapons while hidden, it has Disadvantage on the next Saving Throw against your Clawed Aspect. Additionally, creatures Lacerated by you cannot make Opportunity Attacks.
  • Big Game Hunter. When you use Primal Pounce and your attack hits, you can also attempt to Climb onto a Bigger Creature as per the Additional Combat Actions as a Bonus Action.
  • Disembowel. If you hit a Prone creature with your natural weapons, you can force it to make the Saving Throw against your Clawed Aspect again, ignoring the usual per-turn limit. Once per turn, if the Prone creature is already Lacerated, it takes the damage from the condition immediately after the attack if it fails the Saving Throw.
